page.overview:
Who is Bomberto?

Bomberto plays a minor role in the game only having a trouble that can be done at the Trouble Center. His trouble involves bringing him any type of food. After giving Bomberto a food item (which can even be as something as simple as a Mushroom), he will reward Mario with eleven coins.
